name: Nova SaaS Landing Page
shortDescription: A high-converting SaaS landing page with animated hero, pricing tiers, and lead capture funnel.
description: Nova is a premium SaaS landing page built for a B2B startup. The goal was to communicate product value quickly, build trust, and drive demo sign-ups. I designed and developed a dark-themed, gradient-rich experience with smooth scroll animations and a conversion-focused layout.
features: Animated hero with gradient mesh background
challenges: The client needed a landing page that felt premium but loaded under 2 seconds on mobile networks.
solutions: Implemented static generation, optimized images with next/image, lazy-loaded animations, and minimized JavaScript bundles for fast first paint.

name: Apex Business Corporate Website
shortDescription: Professional corporate website for a consulting firm with service pages, team section, and blog.
description: Apex Business needed a polished corporate presence to attract enterprise clients. I built a multi-page website with a strong brand identity, case studies section, and CMS-ready blog structure for future content marketing.
challenges: Balancing a professional aesthetic with approachable messaging for diverse client segments.
solutions: Created a modular component system with consistent typography, whitespace, and subtle animations that feel enterprise-grade yet welcoming.

name: LuxeStyle E-commerce Store
shortDescription: Premium fashion e-commerce store with product filtering, wishlist, and optimized checkout flow.
description: LuxeStyle is a high-end fashion brand that needed an online store reflecting their premium positioning. I developed a Shopify-powered storefront with custom theme sections, product discovery features, and conversion-optimized product pages.
challenges: Large product catalogs caused slow filtering and poor mobile browsing experience.
solutions: Implemented client-side filtering with debounced search, lazy-loaded product images, and skeleton loading states for perceived performance.

name: MedCare Plus Healthcare Portal
shortDescription: Trust-focused healthcare website with appointment booking, doctor profiles, and patient resources.
description: MedCare Plus required a website that builds patient trust while making it easy to book appointments and find medical information. I designed an accessible, HIPAA-conscious frontend with clear navigation and empathetic visual design.
challenges: Healthcare content must be trustworthy, accessible, and easy to navigate for patients of all ages.
solutions: Used high-contrast typography, clear CTAs, simplified navigation, and structured content blocks following healthcare UX best practices.

name: Prime Estate Realty Platform
shortDescription: Real estate listing platform with property search, map integration, and agent dashboards.
description: Prime Estate needed a modern property listing website to showcase luxury homes and connect buyers with agents. I built a filterable property catalog with map views, detailed listing pages, and lead capture for agent follow-ups.
challenges: Handling hundreds of property listings with images while maintaining fast page loads.
solutions: Built paginated API endpoints, implemented image CDN delivery, and used ISR for listing pages to balance freshness with performance.

name: EduLearn Academy Platform
shortDescription: Online learning platform with course catalog, enrollment system, and student dashboard.
description: EduLearn Academy wanted to expand beyond in-person classes with an online course platform. I developed a full learning management interface with course browsing, enrollment workflows, and progress tracking for students.
challenges: Creating an intuitive learning experience that works for both tech-savvy students and beginners.
solutions: Designed a step-by-step onboarding flow, clear course cards with progress indicators, and a simplified dashboard with minimal cognitive load.

name: TaskFlow Project Manager
shortDescription: Custom project management web app with kanban boards, team collaboration, and real-time updates.
description: TaskFlow is a custom web application for small teams to manage projects collaboratively. I built the full stack from scratch with authentication, kanban boards, task assignments, and notification systems.
challenges: Real-time collaboration without conflicts when multiple users edit the same board.
solutions: Implemented optimistic UI updates with WebSocket sync, conflict resolution on the server, and debounced persistence to MongoDB.
